name: Saraev-like Talking Head
tagline: Raw talking-head footage goes in; a tight, enhanced, captioned cut with a configurable teaser comes out.
description: A deterministic talking-head workflow inspired by Nick Saraev's public videos: voice-activity cuts around half-second silences, user-chosen bad-take markers, audio cleanup, a configurable grade, an optional opening teaser, captions and simple graphics, and hardware-accelerated export when the computer supports it. The exact private tools and settings are not assumed.
bring: The exact word or phrase you say after a bad take, if you use one
Optional: an earlier render or locally held reference for side-by-side comparison
get: A clean 16:9 talking-head video, an auditable edit plan, captions, and short comparison renders

needs.name: Edit template and deterministic helper scripts
Speech to text with word timestamps

stylesNote: grade, caption treatment, graphics and teaser treatment
steps: Inspect and transcribe the raw recording
Detect speech and build an auditable cut around half-second gaps
Remove marked bad takes using the speaker's configured phrase
Enhance audio, grade picture, and add the optional teaser, captions and graphics
Render short samples, compare them, then export with a supported encoder
Review each version in FrameJam until it is approved
